text_block_list.text: Today is academy orientation. We were put in charge of guiding a group of young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Make sure you enjoy
Tracen Academy to the fullest today!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, we're counting on you
as Falco and the team's manager♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Runaway☆Attendants!
Let's do our best☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission Name: "Runaway☆Attendants."
Acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I just get saddled with a weird name...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"This is the training gym.
Commencing training as a sample demonstration."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing! Big sis is so muscular!
Let's do it too! Hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Bourbon-oneechan is special!
None of you should copy her, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yay, such a big course!
Ready, set, go!!" his

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait,
everyone, don't just run off on your own...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Everyone has way too much energy...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, the provision of necessary information is not yet complete.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm starting to worry if Tracen Academy's charm is really getting through to the children...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's it! In that case, let's put on
an extraordinary live show for everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even little kids will surely take an interest once they see how sparkling and radiant Umadols are!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's sing an anime song!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey☆ Falco's got anime songs
firmly in her repertoire, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, follow Falco☆ ――...~~♪
――......~~~~♪♪♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I know this song too. If it's this one...
——...~~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Song understood. Commencing chorus.
――……～～♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's all sing together! ☆

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yup♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Falco-oneechan is so cute!
Sing one more time~!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Looks like everyone's taken an interest.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's sing it one more time♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What about the academy tour...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
First, let's fill their heads with fun memories☆
All right, here we go~☆
And so, having bonded with the children, the subsequent tour of the academy turned out to be a great success.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's the super-popular magical girl anime among kids, right? ☆
Everyone is sure to love that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There you are!
Trainer-san, or should I say, minion of evil!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Magical☆Miracle☆Make Debut☆’!
I'll reform the bad guys with my singing☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—...~~♪
Come on, everyone sing along☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Make the world peaceful through the touching
power of races and concerts, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ Hey, hey, Falco-oneechan,
sing it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty~☆ Then let's sing a song
while we walk around the academy♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yayâª
And so, the voices of the children singing merrily as they toured the academy echoed throughout.
